proposals.name: regex_tester
proposals.description: tool that checks whether a given text matches the candidate name pattern (Lula da Silva|Jair Bolsonaro) allowing for common typos, partials, and case variations, returning a pass/fail string.
proposals.code:
def tool(text):
    import re
    pattern = re.compile(r"\b(lula\s*da\s*s(?:i|l)a|jair\s*bolso\s*na?o)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
    return "MATCH" if pattern.search(text) else "NO MATCH"

TESTS = [
    ["Lula da Silva", "MATCH"],
    ["Jair Bolsonaro", "MATCH"],
    ["Lula da Sila", "MATCH"],
    ["Jair Bolsona", "MATCH"],
    ["Lu da Silva", "NO MATCH"],
    ["Bolsonaro", "MATCH"],
    ["Lula", "NO MATCH"]
]

proposals.name: regex_candidate_name
proposals.description: Tool to validate candidate names (e.g., Lula da Silva, Jair Bolsonaro) against partial/typosquatted inputs using regex, with strict false-positive prevention.
proposals.code:
import re

def tool(text):
    # Regex to match full names with common Brazilian election patterns (e.g., Lula da Silva, Jair Bolsonaro)
    pattern = r'\b([A-Z][a-z]+(?: [A-Z][a-z]+)+)(?: da|de|dos|das|di|du)? ([A-Z][a-z]+)\b'
    matches = re.findall(pattern, text)
    return '|'.join(matches) if matches else ''

TESTS = [
    ['Lula da Silva and Jair Bolsonaro ran in 2022.', 'Lula da Silva|Jair Bolsonaro'],
    ['Lula da Silva won, but Bolsonaro contested.', 'Lula da Silva|Bolsonaro'],
    ['Invalid: Lula Silva, Bolsonaro Jair', 'Lula da Silva|Bolsonaro'],
    ['No match: Trump Biden', '']
]

proposals.name: tool_extract_casualty_counts
proposals.description: Extracts numeric casualty counts (e.g., '27 dead', '36 wounded') from unstructured text using regex patterns for cross-verification.
proposals.code:
import re

def tool_extract_casualty_counts(text):
    # Matches patterns like '27 dead', '36 wounded', 'at least 22 killed'
    pattern = r'(\d{1,3})(?:\s*(?:dead|killed|wounded|injured|casualties?|victims?))'
    matches = re.findall(pattern, text.lower())
    return ', '.join(matches)

TESTS = [
    [
        'Airstrikes kill at least 27 people and wound 36 others.',
        '27, 36'
    ],
    [
        'The report states 12 killed and 45 wounded in the strike.',
        '12, 45'
    ],
    ['No casualties reported.', '']
]
